sent_bad: According to eMarketer, "Amazon had the greatest share of e-commerce sales at 38.7% in 2020; Walmart had the second-greatest share at 5.3%," and the House Subcommittee on Antitrust staff report finds that "a market share of 50% or higher may be a more credible estimate of Amazon's share of online sales, and that over 60% of all U.S. online product searches begin on Amazon."
